Name: Kenneth's Weapon Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A weapon shop you can build on your farm. 5 little shops in one building, full of swords to check out when you're ready[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it is[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A small shop building for your farm. You ask Robin to build it, and after a few days, you have your own place to browse swords[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Inside, there are 5 counters. Each counter opens a different shop, with its own set of swords. Walk up, take a look, and see what fits how you play[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]25 swords to start with, spread across the 5 shops. Some are small and cheap, good for early days. Some are long and heavy, good for deeper mines. A few are the kind you save up for[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check each shop in game when you have time. No rush[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to get it[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Talk to Robin and build Kenneth's Weapon Shop on your farm. It takes 3 days to build[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Once it is up, just walk inside and check the counters. Each sword is sold once a day. You buy with gold plus bars / gems / materials, so bring both when you stop by[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Build the shop with Robin[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Walk inside and check the 5 counters[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Start the game, ask Robin to build the shop, and check it after 3 days[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. This is the base shop. The other Kenneth's sword sets - like Knight Swords, Battle Blades, and the rest - add more swords to these same 5 shops. You can add them anytime, no need to start a new game[/b][/size]
